criteria.note: Billing.jsx renders preview.prorated_charge/next_renewal_price/days_remaining verbatim; no client-side proration arithmetic.
charge_card() (main.py) is a pure function, no network/SDK import; no payment package added to requirements.txt/package.json.
upgrade() (main.py) returns the 402 JSONResponse before any users/billing_data mutation; verified by test_confirm_upgrade_declined_leaves_user_on_standard.
_compute_proration() raises 409 already_premium as its first statement, before charge_card is ever called, on both endpoints.
No assignment to a renew_at key anywhere in the upgrade flow; verified by test_confirm_upgrade_success_flips_plan_and_charges.
